title: Mailgun (mail)
description: Mailgun as gohort's mail, in place of an SMTP server: an API that sends from a domain you verify. Declared as a service you can test and fix from Admin > Connectors.
setup_notes: Create an API key under Mailgun's API Security settings and add your sending domain. A domain in Mailgun's EU region is reached at api.eu.mailgun.net: change the credential's and the connector's address to it. The credential lands disabled: enable it under API Credentials. The connector lands unapproved: approve it in Admin > Extensions > Connectors and run Test on its row, which sends a short test email to the test recipient. Then pick it under Admin > System > Mail (SMTP) as Send with: signup approvals, reports, alerts and the send_email tool go through it. A From Address set there is used in place of the one given here. No price is declared, as it depends on your plan: add a per_call cost to the connector's spec to see what mail costs.
